items.question: Our data can't leave our premises. Can you still build for us?
items.answer: Yes — that is what our Safe Build Protocol is for. We build inside closed environments for government entities and organisations with sensitive data, so nothing ever leaves your walls.

items.question: How do we start working with you?
items.answer: With a free AI readiness assessment. We look at where AI pays off for you first and come back within one business day with an honest read on what to fix first — no commitment and no pitch deck.

items.question: How fast can we see something working?
items.answer: Days, not months. We take an idea to a working prototype quickly, prove the case, and only then talk about larger investment. A scoped prototype typically runs two to six weeks depending on how many systems it has to touch.

items.question: What does a project cost?
items.answer: The readiness assessment is free. Beyond that, a scoped prototype typically starts around OMR 1,500, and larger builds are quoted per engagement once scope is clear. Training is priced separately — public course cohorts run OMR 100–500 per seat, and team training is a single fixed price rather than a per-seat licence.

items.question: Who owns the code and the data?
items.answer: You do. You keep full ownership of the systems we build for you and of everything they process. There is no licence tax and no lock-in to us as a vendor.

items.question: What happens after handover?
items.answer: We hand over the working system, the source, and the documentation — and we train your team to run it. Support and iteration afterwards are available as a separate arrangement rather than assumed.

items.question: Do you work with organisations outside Oman?
items.answer: Yes. We are based in Muscat and work across the GCC in person, and remotely beyond it. Training can be delivered on-site, remote, or hybrid.

items.question: What is the Vibe Coding programme?
items.answer: It takes you from an idea to a deployed product with no programming background. You finish the programme with a real, published product rather than a certificate.

items.question: Do you train teams as well as individuals?
items.answer: Both. Individuals join public cohorts; teams get a syllabus designed around the work they actually do, delivered on-site or remotely, with a manager debrief afterwards on what the team learned and what to deploy next.

items.question: Do you work in Arabic?
items.answer: Arabic and English side by side — consulting, training, and the products themselves. Most AI knowledge never reaches the people who need it in the language they think in; we close that gap.
